items.summary: Self-hosting LLMs on GPUs means paying to recompute the same context on every turn. Distributed KV caching with Amazon ElastiCache can cut inference cost by up to 40% and time to first token by up to 80%. This post walks through the distributed KV caching skill in the Agent Toolkit for AWS, which evaluates and sets up the cache from your coding agent.
items.title: Cut self-hosted LLM cost and latency with the distributed KV caching agent skill

items.summary: The retrieval was perfect. That was the problem. Picture an internal assistant that answers employee questions from a shared document store. Someone asks a reasonable question about bonus timelines. The vector search does exactly what it was built to do and finds the most semantically similar chunks. One of those chunks comes from a compensation review meant only for HR. No model hallucinated, no index was corrupted, and no query timed out. Every component worked as designed, and that’s why no alert fired. The system answered the question it was asked, which was “what is most relevant?” Nobody had asked it “what is this person allowed to see…
items.title: Vibhor Kumar: Relevance Is Not Permission: Filter-First Vector Search in PostgreSQL
